protocol.outdated_rule: Requires dated evidence establishing that the original decision was supportable and that a later change superseded it. Record temporal uncertainty explicitly when historical evidence cannot distinguish incorrect from outdated.

protocol.reprocess_as_comparison_rule: Recommend only when comparison eligibility is independently established; do not infer it merely from resolved external evidence.
protocol.incomplete_batches: Keep pending cases explicit without audit_finding; never count pending cases as audited.
protocol.final_reconciliation: Every excluded target and every current exception must have exactly one completed audit entry per audit_population; report missing in-scope records separately.

UCR has a small, valuable archaeology and heritage group, including Introduction to World Archaeology, Greek Archaeology and Heritage & Ancient Democracy, but it has no excavation training sequence, archaeometric/materials laboratory sequence, European prehistoric-to-medieval archaeology sequence or archaeological thesis requirement. Filling 24 UCR courses with mostly modern history, art, cultural theory or generic research methods would present neighbouring subjects as an Archaeology bachelor. No defensible closest 24-course UCR programme can be formed.

provenance.existing_comparator_source_notes: The 2026–27 OER confirms the exact normalized Dutch-language Archeologie trajectory alongside a separate English-language Archaeology trajectory. Its ordinary 180-EC curriculum is 60 EC of ten compulsory first-year courses; 78 EC of thirteen compulsory post-propaedeutic courses; a 12-EC bachelor thesis in the Dutch trajectory; and 30 EC genuinely free third-year academic profiling space. Field School 1 and 2, materials research, digital archaeology and excavation-to-publication work are prescribed in the ordinary curriculum. The English-track thesis is the same role in a different language and not an extra component. Optional Field School 3 and optional Forensic Archaeology listed among practical teaching activities are not silently counted as compulsory. The OER curriculum table rather than illustrative admissions text establishes the credit accounting.
provenance.existing_ucr_course_evidence: Reviewed the current 151-row enriched UCR workbook, including course profiles, descriptions, topics, methods, prerequisites and Fall 2026–Spring 2029 availability. MCCHEAM112 introduces world archaeology through material culture; MCCHEAM213 studies Greek archaeology; MCCHEAM315 connects Greek ancient democracy with material and heritage questions. MCCHEAM211 treats African art and heritage, MCCHEAM212 Mediterranean Renaissance art, and MCCHEAM111/312/316 art history and museums; these may contribute to an ancient cultures or heritage theme but do not replace systematic archaeological method. GOSHIST111/112/211/311/312 largely focus on modern, imperial or local historical subjects; GOSHIST213 includes ancient warfare but is not excavation archaeology. MCCMEDI112 uses “archaeology” metaphorically for media technology. General qualitative and quantitative methods and environmental field courses do not supply archaeological stratigraphy, supervised digs, finds processing, materials science or the VU research sequence. Thus a 24-course archaeology-led UCR alternative would require more than a handful of genuinely relevant archaeology courses and cannot pass the specific course-to-concept gate.

cases.existing_substantive_exception_reason: VU’s compulsory core centers on medicinal and organic chemistry, molecule design and synthesis, pharmacokinetics, bioanalysis, molecular pharmacology and toxicology laboratory work, followed by an 18-EC pharmaceutical research project. UCR offers relevant biology, biochemistry, pharmacology and disease courses, but no organic chemistry or synthesis sequence, pharmaceutical chemistry laboratory, ADME course, molecular toxicology practical or drug-design capstone. A 24-course biomedical path would represent a different field and obscure the chemical drug-discovery core of this target. The optional biology- or chemistry-focused minor does not remove that compulsory gap.
